# Goldshield

> Goldshield® is a patented, water-stabilised antimicrobial technology that protects hands, surfaces, laundry and FFP3 masks between uses — without alcohol, methanol or harsh chemicals. Developed since 2008, it bonds to a surface at a molecular level and forms a residual, non-leaching antimicrobial layer that keeps working between cleans rather than only at the moment of application.

## Key facts

- Patent: USA 9,089,138.
- Peer-reviewed on 4 separate occasions; findings published in the American Journal of Infection Control.
- Regulatory approvals: EPA Registration #85556-1 (Goldshield 5 concentrate) and #85556-2 (Goldshield 75 ready-to-use); NDC Code 40092-500-12 (Goldshield 24 hand sanitiser); EN 14476 / EN 1650 / EN 1656 / EN 1647 / EN 1657 / EN 1276 / EN 1500; CE-PC-210208-054-01-9A (GO36 FFP3 mask).
- Up to 99.99% effective against illness-causing germs; effective against bacteria, fungi, mould, mildew, algae and yeast.
- Non-leaching: forms a non-migrating bond and does not enter the bloodstream, so it does not contribute to antimicrobial resistance ("super-bugs").
- Product range: 24 Hour Hand Sanitiser, 14-Day Surface Disinfectant & Protector, Laundry Protector, FFP3 Antiviral & Antibacterial Mask (GO36).
- Used across 20+ industry sectors including healthcare, hospitality, schools, food & beverage, government/military, transportation and agriculture.
- Registered address: Unit 2C, Churnet Park, James Brindley Road, Leek, Staffordshire, ST13 8YH, United Kingdom.
